name: comp-364

frames.best_why: Hover card is fully open below the name, showing portrait, bio and the mutual-friend row.

tagline: Hovering a name opens a small profile card with bio and mutual friends.
summary: A name with avatar and handle reveals a profile card on hover. The card repeats the person's photo, name and handle, adds a short bio, and shows overlapping friend avatars with a mutual-friend count.
appearance: A small row on a dark page: a round portrait, a bold name link, and a grey handle beneath. Hovering opens a dark rounded card below with the same portrait and name, a short bio, and three overlapping small avatars beside '3 mutual friends'.
behaviour: Hovering the name fades in the card below it; moving the pointer into the card keeps it open, and leaving dismisses it.
demo_content: Person Keith Kennedy, handle @k.kennedy, designer bio at @coss.com, and '3 mutual friends'.
search_phrases: hover a name to see profile details
user card with bio and mutual friends
mini profile card that appears on hover
see someone's bio without leaving the page
use_when: Names in a feed or comment should reveal who someone is without a page load.
avoid_when: Hover cards need a pointer; touch users cannot open this and must tap through instead.
customise: The name, handle, bio, photo paths and mutual-friend count are all fixed in the file; swapping in real people means editing the source.
weight_why: A few images and a small popup; it only appears on hover.

a11y.note: The trigger is a paragraph wrapping a link, so keyboard focus may not open the card; avatar alt text is generic.

issues: The card opens on hover only; the trigger element itself is not focusable.
Avatar alt text is generic ('Avatar', 'Friend 01') rather than naming the people.
polish_why: Well spaced and legible; otherwise a conventional profile hover card.
title: User Profile Hovercard
